verdict.rationale: Jina Reader's core purpose is converting any URL into clean, LLM-ready Markdown/text, avoiding manual HTML parsing and handling JS rendering, anti-bot blocking, and headless browsing behind the scenes, with configurable output formats (frontmatter, JSON, chunked) tailored to AI agents. Community reports show some auth/404 errors on certain deployments, but the core capability is well documented and corroborated. Missing for 10: broader independent benchmarking of output quality/reliability across diverse sites beyond one HN anecdote of failure.
